title: ADF land comment reply
description: The fields of one tracker issue's hand-off comment after the change's merge: what was done, how a tester checks it, and for a partial issue what remains. Plain text only; the tracker plugin renders its own comment from the fields and adds the merge request link itself. land.mjs comment also refuses what the schema cannot see: a key or state other than the dispatch's, a missing or empty field, remains on a taken issue, a field over its word limit over all its lines (done 80, test 120, remains 80), and a link or URL in any field.

text.description: A list of short plain-text lines, preferred; one text is accepted too. The core splits every text at its line breaks and sends the provider a list of one-line texts, each rendered as a line of a numbered list.
